remarksWeb: Note no. 1 A-      Table II  Statement showing shareholding pattern of Promoter and Promoter Group 1.       Indian (a)    Individuals/Hindu Undivided Family In tab: INDHUF in Column W and X- Explanation for shares reflecting in number of shares pledged or otherwise encumbered (XIII) and for Row W17-          As per the terms of an order dated January 16, 2020 passed by the Honble Bombay High Court (HC) (read with its modified order dated January 30, 2020) in I.A. No. 1 of 2020 in Petition No. 2972 of 2018, Mrs. Pooja Bajaj, acting in her capacity as the mother and natural guardian of her minor son  Master Vanraj Bajaj, had submitted an undertaking to the HC that the 1/3rd share, being the allocated share of Master Vanraj Bajaj, from and out of the estate of his deceased father  Late Mr. Anant Bajaj (including 18,43,556  equity shares in the Company), shall be kept aside and not to be dealt with during the minority of Master Vanraj Bajaj, without the prior leave of the HC.             The said non-disposal undertaking amounted to an encumbrance upon the said 18,43,556 equity shares in the Company (which was made effective/formalized by way of debit freeze on July 3, 2020).            The said encumbrance was in terms of an order of HC and hence there is no pledge/encumbrance to that effect in the depository records. However, to maintain uniformity in disclosures at group level, the Bajaj Group Companies (including the Bajaj Electricals Limited) have decided to show the shareholding of Master Vanraj Bajaj as pledged / encumbered shares during his minority.
